sections.title: AI Provider
sections.description: Which language model service to call, and how to reach it.

fields.title: Provider
fields.help_text: How the request is made. The commandline option keeps API keys out of WordPress: the script owns its own credentials.

fields.title: Commandline Command
fields.help_text: Shell command to run. A single JSON argument is appended containing the prompt and the content to process; the command must print the model's response on stdout.

fields.title: Command Timeout (seconds)
fields.help_text: How long a single call may take before it is killed. The server's own limits (max_execution_time, proxy read timeouts) must all exceed this for a longer value to have any effect.

fields.title: Access Key
fields.help_text: API token for the selected provider. Not needed, and not stored, for the commandline provider.

fields.title: Endpoint
fields.help_text: Optional: override the default API endpoint for the selected provider.
